parser: page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor), full pages joined by one newline; check exact font alignment

formulas.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

calibration: Visible glyph identity only. Every substitution is bound to original text-showing operator index, part, byte offset, encoded byte and font, as well as extracted codepoint, page, offset and context. All non-whitespace source extraction characters are aligned with decoded original bytes. No whitespace glyph exists; generated layout whitespace is preserved. No linguistic/mathematical correction, dehyphenation, coalescing, reordering or deletion.

comparison_policy.written: sum of all three whole source manuscript costs / (whole U_D + D1 + D2 + D3)
comparison_policy.including_program: same numerator / (whole U_D + D1 + D2 + D3 + whole CODE)
comparison_policy.conditional: source_i / D_i after acquiring the whole U_D and whole declared complete programme boundary, including all five required programs; diagnostic parts are not silently dropped

predecessor.status: Preserved historical proposal; L066 calibrated glyph identities corrected by this additive edition.
